title: CHOOSE GUEST OR SIGN IN
caption: Book as a guest, or sign in to save 5%.
voice: Book as a guest, or sign in or create an account to save five percent.

title: ENTER RIDER DETAILS
caption: Enter the passenger information.
voice: Enter the passenger name, phone number, and email.

title: CONFIRM THE RIDER
caption: Confirm to unlock the next section.
voice: Select Confirm Details to unlock the pickup and destination section.

title: ADD PICKUP + DESTINATION
caption: Enter each address or add multiple stops.
voice: Enter the pickup address and destination. You can also add multiple stops.

title: CONFIRM THE ROUTE
caption: Confirm every required stop.
voice: Select Confirm Details after every required stop is entered.

title: CHOOSE THE RIDE TYPE
caption: Select the transportation support needed.
voice: Choose the ride type and transportation support the passenger needs.

title: SET DATE + APPOINTMENT
caption: Pickup time and fare update automatically.
voice: Set the trip date and appointment time. Nexus calculates the pickup estimate.

title: REVIEW ROUTE VISIBILITY
caption: Preview the route and live fleet visibility.
voice: Review the route preview and live fleet visibility for the ride.

title: REVIEW THE FARE
caption: Check distance, ETA, and estimated fare.
voice: Review the distance, estimated arrival time, and fare before booking.

title: CONFIRM THE FARE
caption: Review the estimate, then confirm the rate.
voice: Review the estimated rate, then select Confirm Rate to continue.

title: BOOK MY RIDE
caption: Submit the completed ride request.
voice: When every section is complete, select Book My Ride to submit the request.

title: BOOKING CONFIRMED
caption: Save the reference number for updates.
voice: The booking is confirmed. Save the reference number for ride updates.

title: CHOOSE PAYMENT
caption: Pay a 25% deposit or pay the fare in full.
voice: Choose to pay a twenty five percent deposit, or pay the estimated fare in full.
